dialogues.jp:
音楽室にヤローの低い声と、女子の綺麗な高い
歌声が響きわたる。
dialogues.en:
The high-pitched voices of pretty girls, and the low-pitched
voices of idiots, reverberated throughout the music room.
dialogues.text:
The high-pitched voices of pretty girls, and the low-pitched
voices of idiots, reverberated throughout the music room.

dialogues.jp: （やっぱ女子の歌声は耳に心地いいな）
dialogues.en:
"(In the end, a girl's singing voice is always easier on the
ears.)"
dialogues.text:
"(In the end, a girl's singing voice is always easier on the
ears.)"

dialogues.jp: あの中心に座って、じっくりと聴きたいものだ。
dialogues.en: I sat in the middle of the noise, hearing every note.
dialogues.text: I sat in the middle of the noise, hearing every note.

dialogues.jp:
俺のハーレムな夢想を無視して、音楽の授業が
滞りなく進んでいく。
dialogues.en:
I ended up daydreaming in the middle of the class waiting
for it to pass by, imagining all the voices around me my
harem.
dialogues.text:
I ended up daydreaming in the middle of the class waiting
for it to pass by, imagining all the voices around me my
harem.

dialogues.jp:
音楽の授業。ヤローの声は耳障りだが、女子の
高い綺麗な声には癒される。
dialogues.en:
It was music lessons. The voices of the guys were pain to my
ears, while the beautiful voices of the girls were the exact
iopposite.
dialogues.text:
It was music lessons. The voices of the guys were pain to my
ears, while the beautiful voices of the girls were the exact
iopposite.

dialogues.jp:
中心に座って女子に囲まれるようにして、聞き
たいところだ。
dialogues.en: I sat in the center of all the camaderie and listened.
dialogues.text: I sat in the center of all the camaderie and listened.
